purpose: Teach: 稀/読み方/目先/義父/うるさく/柔らかい/恥ずかしく/嫁さん

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、稀、絶対、に、絶対、来るお客様、絶対、覚えてる?メイちゃん
lines.en: Do you remember that customer who barely ever comes in?
lines.style: Warm curiosity. Soft leading tone, like inviting Aoi into a shared memory. Unhurried. Small lift at the end—not demanding, asking.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の名前の、本気で、絶対、読み方、絶対、お客様に、絶対、聞かれるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, customers ask me about how to pronounce the shop's name all the time.
lines.style: Wistful, half-musing. Like she's noticing something for the first time while saying it aloud. Gentle, not complaining. Trailing into reflection.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、目先、絶対、の売上、絶対、追いすぎてもね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, sometimes I think you focus too much on the numbers in front of you.
lines.style: Tender concern underneath a steady tone. Not lecturing—observing. Slight pause before 'focus.' The voice of someone who notices what others miss.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、義父、絶対、が、絶対、お店、絶対、見に来てくれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Actually, my father-in-law came by the shop the other day.
lines.style: Bright, almost proud. A little lift in the middle like she's sharing good news. Warm energy—proud of something beyond herself. Clean, open delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お隣のお店、本気で、絶対、うるさく、絶対、なってきたわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The shop next door has gotten so loud lately, hasn't it?
lines.style: Dry observation with a hint of exasperation underneath. Not bitter—just noticing. Light, conversational rhythm. A moment of shared frustration.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新メニューの、絶対、お肉、絶対、柔らかい、絶対、よ、メイちゃん、本気for
lines.en: The new meat on the menu is really tender, you know.
lines.style: Animated, encouraging. Leaning forward slightly in the voice. Pride in the detail. Wanting Aoi to know something good. Bright but genuine, not overselling.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、恥ずかしく、絶対、なくていいわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You don't need to be embarrassed about any of this.
lines.style: Quiet reassurance. Firm but tender. Like she's giving Aoi permission to stop apologizing. Steady eye contact in the voice. No drama—just clarity.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お兄ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、嫁さん、絶対、お店に、絶対、来てくれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: My brother's wife came by the shop too.
lines.style: Warm, almost delighted. Building energy from the previous line. Animated but not breathless—savoring the fact that people are showing up. Open, bright delivery.
